preconditions.description: The number of strings n is between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(strings[i]) <= 10 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each string in the list of strings has a length between 1 and 10 inclusive.
The number of questions Q is between 1 and 500000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= n for L, R, _ in questions)
preconditions.description: For each question, L and R are between 1 and n inclusive, and L is less than or equal to R.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(query_str) <= 10 for _, _, query_str in questions)
preconditions.description: Each query string has a length between 1 and 10 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of questions Q.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) and 0 <= count <= R - L + 1 for count, (L, R, _) in zip(output, questions))
postconditions.description: Each output count is an integer between 0 and R - L + 1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == sum(query_str in strings[j-1] for j in range(L, R+1)) for i, (L, R, query_str) in enumerate(questions))
postconditions.description: Each output count correctly represents the number of strings from L to R that contain the query string as a substring.
